landing.title: Talk to your documents, get answers in seconds
landing.subtitle: Upload PDFs, Word, Excel and slide decks; get page-referenced answers, summaries, quizzes and translations.

features.chatBody: Every answer cites its source so you can verify the exact page in one click.
features.toolsBody: Summary, key points, quiz, translation, data extraction and document comparison.
features.teamBody: Role-based access, expiring share links and a full activity history.

landing.securityBody: Tenant-level isolation, encrypted 2FA secrets, tamper-evident audit logs and GDPR-compliant data export.

onboarding.title: Getting started
onboarding.step1Body: Drag and drop a PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, TXT or MD file.
onboarding.step2Body: Ask a question and see which page the answer came from.
onboarding.step3Body: Generate a summary or quiz, then export the result as PDF.

cookies.message: We only use essential cookies to run the service. Analytics cookies require your consent.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.controllerBody: DocAssistant processes your account details and uploaded documents to provide the service.
privacy.dataBody: Email, name, organization details, uploaded documents and the AI output derived from them.
privacy.rightsBody: You can download all of your data as JSON at any time and permanently delete your account and data.
privacy.retentionBody: When you delete your account, your documents and derived output are removed from storage as well.
privacy.contactBody: For privacy requests write to privacy@docassistant.local.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.serviceBody: DocAssistant is an AI-powered SaaS for document analysis, provided as is.
terms.accountBody: You are responsible for your account security. Change your password and enable 2FA if you suspect access.
terms.contentBody: You confirm you hold the rights to documents you upload. Illegal content may not be uploaded.
terms.billingBody: Subscriptions renew monthly. On cancellation the plan falls back to Free at the end of the period.
terms.liabilityBody: AI output can contain errors; verify the source document before making critical decisions.

account.title: Data and privacy
account.exportBody: Export everything associated with your account as JSON.
account.deleteBody: Your account and any organization you solely own will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.
account.confirmLabel: I understand this cannot be undone
